QuestInfo.name: Revenge and Growth
QuestInfo.0: A difficult mission that will have you fighting against the Black Wings is about to begin. Go to the #bResistance Underground Base#k and talk to #b#p2151002##k in order to hear the details of the mission.
QuestInfo.1:
There is a Black Wing returning to Edelstein with important intelligence. Your mission is to eliminate them and retrieve the intelligence. #p2151002# says that you can expect to see someone familiar... You worry about what she could mean... In any case, go to #b#m310000010##k.

#i4032738# #t4032738# #b#c4032738#/1#k
QuestInfo.2: The person you met during your mission was the Black Wing member you ran into while rescuing #p2151005#! Back then, he was more powerful than you, but this time, you were able to handle him with ease. When you reported the results to #p2151002#, she gave you a job advancement, so that you could use even stronger skills.

0.0: Ready for your next mission? Your objective is to #bdefeat an agent of the Black Wings, and steal the report they are carrying.#k This report contains crucial intel about the world beyond Edelstein.
0.1: Don't think for a moment this'll be some cakewalk. The Black Wings provide increased security any time they're delivering important items or messages. The Black Wings agent they'll be entrusting this report to is pretty tough. That said, this mission is extremely important. Without this information, the Resistance is blind.
0.2: I know you've been training. I wouldn't give you this mission if I didn't think you could handle it, but don't be under any illusions. This task will be a difficult one. Are you sure you're up for it?

yes.0: Good. Head to the Air Field. The Black Wings agent should have arrived at the #b#m310000010##k by now. Defeat him and bring me that report!
yes.1: You may run into an... 'old friend' there. Don't get spooked. Consider this an opportunity to show off everything you've learned. Good luck, kiddo!

no.0: How can you decline this task? Think about why you joined the Resistance in the first place...

item.0: Hm, you haven't completed the mission. When you go to the #b#m310000010##k, you'll see a member of the Black Wings carrying a report from the outside world. Eliminate him and take the #breport#k.
